selected.title: Japan’s new mission is heading to Mars’ moons to bring back samples
selected.summary: Japan launched the Martian Moons eXploration mission to study Phobos and Deimos, with a planned sample return to Earth in 2031.
selected.why_it_matters: Samples could help answer whether Mars’ small moons are captured asteroids or formed from material around Mars, while adding another international sample-return effort.
selected.challenge_question: Which Martian moon is the MMX mission planned to collect a sample from?
selected.answer_explanation: The Japanese MMX mission is designed to study Mars’ moons and collect a sample from Phobos for return to Earth. The mission also plans observations of Deimos.
selected.butterfly_question: What could a handful of moon dust reveal about how an entire planetary system formed?
